subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as a focused typed feature or folded into the broader Anthropic context-management API?
rationale: The runtime behavior is well specified, but the focused issue and broader passthrough tracker propose different compatibility-sensitive public configuration boundaries.

options.title: Focused typed compaction
options.body: Implement the complete current compaction lifecycle behind a narrow Anthropic opt-in and keep unrelated native context features separate.

options.title: Unified context management
options.body: Design one broader Anthropic provider surface for compaction, context editing, memory, and future native capabilities before implementation.

options.title: Decline native support
options.body: Retain OpenClaw client-side compaction as the supported path and document Anthropic-native compaction as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Focused typed compaction
recommendation.body: Implement the complete current compaction lifecycle behind a narrow Anthropic opt-in and keep unrelated native context features separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior focused review and current source history connect this person to the relevant provider, configuration, and product boundary.
